name: skillora
description: Skillora - full-stack Learning Management System with live classes (MERN + WebRTC + FFmpeg + HLS + BullMQ + Redux Toolkit)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @skillora/shared && npm run build -w @skillora/api && npm run build -w @skillora/worker && npm run build -w @skillora/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @skillora/shared && npm run typecheck -w @skillora/api && npm run typecheck -w @skillora/worker && npm run typecheck -w @skillora/web
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:api
scripts.test:api: npm run build:shared && vitest run --project api
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
